- **Faster onset, poorer quality:** Alcohol acts as a sedative early on, which can shorten the time it takes to nod off. - **Add alcohol-free days:** Taking breaks from drinking helps restore normal sleep cycles and morning alertness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF15pyuqE87b6b4WzpSZdlhcy-ZOOv3cVJGY3WpKiF5RkEY9iim1iucW7IRcPEvCVJef5imP3wvLLL8NgG3e5Wv2TMmc328YSdmJMWW0sZ47_7tbZabYUmvmPJW8JtbHpRzdI7RfgzJNf5sxQqCeEf8Y8qbWz-6-tUlsBFTBz9aPl5hQM)

items.title: How Alcohol Affects Sleep
items.text: Faster onset, poorer quality: Alcohol acts as a sedative early on, which can shorten the time it takes to nod off. As your body metabolizes it, a rebound effect causes frequent awakenings and lighter, more fragmented sleep. Less REM sleep: Even low amounts of alcohol delay and reduce Rapid Eye Movement (REM) sleep—a stage important for memory, mood, and feeling rested. Nighttime disruptions: Alcohol relaxes throat muscles, worsening snoring and sleep apnea. Its diuretic effect also increases trips to the bathroom and dehydration. Long-term risks: Relying on alcohol for sleep can worsen insomnia over time and build tolerance. Mixing alcohol with sedatives or sleep medications can be dangerous.

- **Keep amounts low:** Smaller amounts cause less sleep disruption than heavier drinking.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESfgHEIkXXZpo592mg61jGt5ohttUOShJI1ol0DBnG65ISeYdS4cauKzoTqis5KHvLPLeaDRqhZPHgMAHVByVH27WrX_SdPZu1mO5cqiO8aakzzFd3OT8cKfXzasDfhgLwycMGDT1OHa_IuAkCQLPyndIw7QuA362S1bimmxidOA)[[2]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAESlgEBxCJF1wFfeiHs_YbYpYeh4Cb5E_84wqTe4fLfpdrsWShSXhG7GIlTmDJAB8D_ZJIshXaKW6J6GQZMKiwV50tS72fCVKImCBqvMC9ZfvKC1Srbs8QcHWo66FYvYQk87P4q1yIUhl9XbDnN6TE2x8Q3PE05uIoPma8BjmafxFaI4K9tZOelmUh2bkCSrxAKIweJRJnCalg)
- **Add alcohol-free days:** Taking breaks from drinking helps restore normal sleep cycles and morning alertness.[[1]](https://google.com/goto?url=CAEShwEBxCJF15pyuqE87b6b4WzpSZdlhcy-ZOOv3cVJGY3WpKiF5RkEY9iim1iucW7IRcPEvCVJef5imP3wvLLL8NgG3e5Wv2TMmc328YSdmJMWW0sZ47_7tbZabYUmvmPJW8JtbHpRzdI7RfgzJNf5sxQqCeEf8Y8qbWz-6-tUlsBFTBz9aPl5hQM)
